claim: Delegate read-only analysis of untrusted documents to cheap controller agents (Haiku, medium effort) but treat every output as claims: verify a sample against source before relaying. The 2026-11-10 spot checks confirmed lock-design line references and explained a 50 versus 60 ms p95 conflict, and showed one controller finding was real but historical.

decisions.notes: Five background controllers on 2026-11-10 read 39 plan documents and drafted two designs; orchestrator sent all LAN replies.
